details.usageInstructions:
Usage: Pour 4 capfuls into half a
bucket of water (4 litres) to remove tough dirt, stains, and germs
Application: Wipe in one
direction only. Allow the surface to dry naturally for disinfection
Fresh Dilution: Always use a
freshly prepared dilution
Precaution: Always spot test on a
small, inconspicuous area to check compatibility before use
Avoid On: Do not use on linoleum,
aluminium, wood, brass, or finished surfaces

details.usageInstructions: Hold upright and close to the pre-cleaned surface, spray all over. Do not touch any surface before it is completely dry. Always test for suitability on a small surface. For mobile-first check the manufacture’s guide for cleaning recommendations. Switch off the mobile device and unplug all leads before use. Spray onto cloth/tissue and wipe gently on a mobile device and allow to dry. Do not use on coated mobile screens. To apply on devices like keyboards and mouse, first, switch off and unplug completely; then spray on cloth or tissue and gently wipe on the surface. Allow it to dry.
